title: Nested tests start and stop Quarkus multiple times
body:
### Describe the bug

Due to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/39229 i couldn't write nested tests, the profile's config would be shared across tests. After it got fixed via https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/44117, i tried to write some nested tests but i observed that the nested tests which have defined a profile, makes the app to start/stop 3 times and then the test gets executed. Nested tests without (default) profile does not trigger that start/stop. This https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/45336 might be related.

If you run the following test:

```java
@QuarkusTest
class ManifestTest {

    @Nested
    class DefaultManifestTest {
        @Test
        void testManifestDefaultValuesAreNotOverwritten() {
            given()
                    .when().get("/hello")
                    .then()
                    .statusCode(200)
                    .body(is("Hello from Quarkus REST"));
        }
    }

    @Nested
    @TestProfile(OverwrittenManifestTest.OverwrittenValuesManifestProfile.class)
    class OverwrittenManifestTest {

        public static class OverwrittenValuesManifestProfile implements QuarkusTestProfile {
        }

        @Test
        void testManifestDefaultValuesAreOverwritten() {
            given()
                    .when().get("/hello")
                    .then()
                    .statusCode(200)
                    .body(is("Hello from Quarkus REST"));
        }
    }


    @Nested
    @TestProfile(DisabledManifestTest.DisabledManifestProfile.class)
    class DisabledManifestTest {

        public static class DisabledManifestProfile implements QuarkusTestProfile {
        }

        @Test
        void testManifestIsDisabled() {
            given()
                    .when().get("/hello")
                    .then()
                    .statusCode(200)
                    .body(is("Hello from Quarkus REST"));

        }
    }

}
```

If you notice the test `testManifestDefaultValuesAreNotOverwritten`, which is in the default profile, only stop once.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Clone the [reproducer](https://github.com/gbourant/inner-test-bug)
2. mvn test
3. See the logs

The reproducer also contains the nested tests to dedicated test classes in which the start/stop does not happen multiple times.
